event_text: Airbyte's status page opens an incident for data syncs failing or delayed
Airbyte says users now see HTTP 502 errors in its web app and API and ties them to the incident
Airbyte says it found a security incident it believes is part of a broader, global cyberattack, and took Cloud offline
notes: 21:09 UTC on the status page; trackers cite its X post at about 21:01 UTC.

event_text: Airbyte begins 'gradually returning services' to Cloud, starting with backend syncs for some customers
Airbyte says Airbyte Cloud is back online, with Connector Builder and MCP offline until further notice
notes: 07:54 UTC, time of Airbyte's own X post.

event_text: Airbyte says most data syncs and database connectors work; API sources, Connector Builder and MCP are unavailable
Salesforce posts an advisory that it disabled the Airbyte connected app after suspicious activity
Airbyte lists 16 API connectors still down because OAuth is deactivated
Airbyte says Intercom OAuth is fixed; 15 API connectors, Connector Builder and MCP stay down
notes: 06:00 UTC. Airbyte said on Nov 23 that the Intercom part was posted in error (t010).

event_text: Airbyte says its note that Intercom was fixed was posted in error; 16 API connectors, Connector Builder and MCP stay down
Airbyte says the API connectors stay unavailable while its partners complete their own reviews and will return as each provider approves
notes: 19:55 UTC. Latest update on the page when we checked.

event_text: Airbyte says new Shopify connectors will fail while it reviews last week's incident with Shopify, and that it has rotated Shopify tokens
Airbyte pauses all syncs on Airbyte Cloud to investigate an issue
Airbyte says Cloud syncs have resumed; the API connectors stay unavailable pending the partners' reviews
notes: 02:12 UTC Nov 26. Latest update on the page when we checked.
